description: This is a Java interface defining email-related services within the sales manager core business system. It specifies methods for sending HTML emails, retrieving email configuration, and saving email configurations.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: An interface for email-related operations such as sending emails and managing email configurations.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to a specified merchant store, potentially throws ServiceException or generic Exception.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration for a given merchant store.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided email configuration for a merchant store.
